Marta (Finance): Heads-up from partner Opsly — they flagged a $1,200 unexpected credit on their April invoice. Can someone check?
Noah (Acct Manager): I pulled INV-2026-0991. There's two identical lines 'PROMO-Q2-2026 1200 USD' — customer says they only qualified once.
Diego (Billing Ops): We ran promo-backfill on 2026-04-10. I'll scan the backfill logs for acct ops-307.
Diego (Billing Ops): logs:
2026-04-10T03:01:12Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260410 acct=ops-307 apply_credit promo=PROMO-Q2-2026 amt=1200 idempotency_token=tok-7a
2026-04-10T03:01:12Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260410 acct=ops-307 apply_credit promo=PROMO-Q2-2026 amt=1200 idempotency_token=tok-7a attempts=2
Noah (Acct Manager): Looks like the job retried and re-applied without dedupe.
Marta (Finance): Policy: reverse accidental duplicate promo credits. Create a reversal of $1,200 and note "duplicate promo-backfill". Notify customer with clear wording.
Diego (Billing Ops): Queuing reversal now: vb adjust-reversal --acct ops-307 --amount 1200 --invoice INV-2026-0991 --code REV-PROMO --note "duplicate promo-backfill"
ops-bot: Action queued: reversal_pending | id=BILL-6221 | acct=ops-307 | amt=1200 USD
Diego (Billing Ops): Reversal posted txn=RV-2026-9C2B. Added rc tag promo-backfill-idempotency.
Noah (Acct Manager): Sent partner note: "Hi — we found a duplicate promo credit applied in error. We've posted a reversal of $1,200 (txn RV-2026-9C2B). This will appear on your next statement as a reversal line. Sorry for the confusion; we're making the backfill idempotent. — Noah"
Marta (Finance): Thanks. Please add a postmortem card on the billing board with remediation: add idempotency checks and a dry-run verification step. Closing once ledger reconciles.
